_comment: Sources crawled on every run. Adding a source = adding a line here (great first PR). `feeds` are RSS/Atom. `pages` are for labs without a feed: the crawler reads the news index and opens article links under `articlePath`. URLs are best-effort; fix them as sites move.
_blocked: Hosts whose stories must never be stored, e.g. after a publisher asks to be removed. The next run deletes their existing stories too.
